content.line: Drinking, dog walking, even feeding the birds, all activities now considered criminal in hundreds of London's parks. content.speaker: PERSON_2
content.line: Disconcertingly, many boroughs in London have now hired private contractors to carry out the enforcement of these fines. Phil Morris knows all about them. content.line: So just who are Xfor? The private security and surveillance firm are the main providers of so-called enforcement officers in the UK.
